ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, authorized signatories, and counterparties against the OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists, UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, EU Consolidated Sanctions List, UK Sanctions List, and Belize Financial Intelligence Unit published designations. Enhanced due diligence is required for politically exposed persons, persons connected to high-risk or sanctioned jurisdictions, and all digital storefront payment processors. Adverse media checks, FATF compliance review, and source-of-funds verification are compulsory under Chapter 105 and the FATF Recommendations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (BCCAR) Electronic Registry Portal (e-Registry)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be recorded in Latin script; a non-English name must be transliterated into the Latin alphabet and, if requested by the Registrar, accompanied by an English translation. The name must include a legal element or suffix such as 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation', 'Inc.', or 'Corp.' and must not mislead as to the entity's nature, licensing status, or activities.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: and any other term that implies ministerial authorization, public office, regulated financial services, or licensed gaming, unless the corresponding consent or license is produced
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If a proposed name is rejected, the applicant may file a written reconsideration request with the Registrar within 14 days of the rejection notice, setting out the legal and factual basis for approval. If the Registrar maintains the refusal, the applicant may appeal to the Minister responsible for financial services within 21 days of the reconsideration decision and may ultimately seek judicial review in the Supreme Court of Belize under the Supreme Court of Judicature Act.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are permissible for general correspondence, marketing, and back-office support, but the IBC must maintain a statutory registered office at the address of its licensed registered agent in Belize. The registered agent must maintain a physical Belize address able to accept service of process and statutory records. For a social casino and virtual slots publishing business, the registered office cannot be a mere virtual address; it must be a genuine, professional location maintained by the registered agent.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low to moderate: approximately 10% baseline annual probability for a standard IBC, rising to 20-30% for an enhanced-risk digital publishing and in-app payment business. Unannounced physical inspections by BCCAR or the Belize Financial Intelligence Unit are not routine but may occur on reasonable suspicion, adverse intelligence, or targeted AML/CFT examination.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Business Companies Act (Revised Edition 2020), Chapter 270 of the Laws of Belize (IBC Act) - incorporation by Articles under ss. 4-6; registered office and registered agent requirements under Part III; share capital rules under Part IV; directors and officers provisions under Part V; tax exemption certification under s. 92.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Companies Registry, Office of the Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Finance, Government of Belize, Belize City, Belize; filings are accepted through licensed Belize registered agents.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation in the statutory form prescribed under the Belize IBC Act, filed with the Registrar of Companies; incorporation is completed upon issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; the IBC Act permits authorized share capital of US$50,000 or 50,000 no-par-value shares and imposes no statutory escrow, capital contribution, or paid-up capital milestone before incorporation. Shares may be allotted by board resolution for cash, services, or other lawful consideration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: BE IT RESOLVED, that (1) the share subscription of the founding subscriber for 100 ordinary shares at US$0.01 par value per share is hereby accepted, and the shares are allotted, issued, and entered in the register of members; (2) the registered office at the registered agent's office in Belize City, Belize is adopted together with the Registered Agency Agreement; (3) the initial director is appointed as sole Director and President, and the corporate secretary is appointed as Secretary, each effective immediately; (4) the corporate seal is adopted and the Secretary is authorized to issue share certificates and certified copies of these resolutions. All acts taken pursuant to this resolution are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Registry, Office of the Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Finance, Government of Belize
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a name reservation application with the Registry to secure the proposed corporate name. The Registrar screens the name against the electronic index of registered Belize IBCs and domestic companies and against restricted words such as bank, insurance, trust, or assurance, which require special regulatory approval. Upon clearance, the name is reserved for a statutory period of up to 30 days pending incorporation.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application in statutory form
Statement of corporate objects and first subscriber identification
Authenticated passport copy of the founding subscriber
Letter of engagement appointing the Belize registered agent
Receipted payment of the name reservation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused for similarity or restriction, file an administrative objection with the Registrar within 14 days or resubmit up to three alternative preferred names; the reservation period may be extended upon payment of the token renewal fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engagement of Belize Licensed Registered Agent and Drafting of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent regulated under the Belize IBC Act and supervised by the Belize Financial Services Commission
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Retain a Belize-licensed registered agent who prepares the Articles of Incorporation in the prescribed statutory form, including the company name, registered office address in Belize, identity of the registered agent, authorized share capital, and permitted objects covering the publishing of simulated social casino and virtual slots software. The founding subscriber executes the Articles and the Registered Agency Agreement; the registered agent executes its consent to act; all documents are dated within the name reservation window.
required_dossiers: Name Reservation Certificate
Draft Articles of Incorporation on the statutory template
Executed Registered Agency Agreement and Consent of Registered Agent
Beneficial ownership declaration of the founding subscriber
Proposed corporate governance pack including draft minutes and registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent or the Registry flags a drafting defect, such as an insufficient objects clause, revise by a rectification schedule or restated Articles executed by the subscriber before filing; no additional government fee applies at the draft stage.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing of Articles of Incorporation and Payment of Incorporation Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Registry, Office of the Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Finance, Government of Belize
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent submits the executed Articles of Incorporation in original and duplicate, the registered office consent, and the registered agent consent to the Registry, together with the government incorporation fee of US$100. The Registry stamps the duplicate as filed and commences the incorporation review; the effective time of filing determines the statutory date of incorporation.
required_dossiers: Executed Articles of Incorporation in original and duplicate
Consent to Act as Registered Agent
Consent to Registered Office
Name Reservation Certificate
Government filing fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a query or notice of defective filing, the registered agent must file corrective documentation within 14 days or such shorter period stated in the notice; unresolved queries result in withdrawal with refund of the government fee and immediate re-filing under a fresh cover note.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Registry Extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Registry, Office of the Registrar of Companies, Government of Belize
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review, the Registrar enters the company in the Register of International Business Companies and issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the registration number, incorporation date, and corporate name. The registered agent obtains certified copies of the registered Articles and the Certificate for the corporate kit and verifies all data against the subscriber's instructions.
required_dossiers: Approved incorporation file
Company number allocation record
Certified copy of the filed Articles of Incorporation
Certificate of Incorporation as officially issued
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any clerical error in the Certificate or Registry record shall be cured by a written request for rectification to the Registrar under the IBC Act, accompanied by a statutory declaration of the registered agent; rectification is ordinarily effected within 5 business days at no fee where the error is manifest.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board of Directors Meeting and Adoption of Corporate Governance Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the IBC constituted under the Articles; facilitated by the licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or secure a unanimous written resolution of the initial director addressing the acceptance of the founding subscriber's share subscription and allotment of shares, adoption of the registered office and Registered Agency Agreement, appointment of the initial director and corporate secretary, and adoption of the corporate seal, banking resolutions, and signatory authorities. Execute the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution, issue share certificates, and open the statutory registers.
required_dossiers: Notice of first board meeting or written consent circular
Executed Pro-Forma First Board Resolution covering share subscription, registered office, and officer appointments
Share subscription agreement and issued share certificates
Register of members, register of directors, and register of officers
Corporate seal procurement record
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a quorum or execution defect is identified, cure it by a written board resolution signed by all directors or a re-convened meeting ratifying prior appointments nunc pro tunc; the executed minutes are retained in the company's statutory records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Completion of Statutory Corporate Records and Certified Corporate Kit Delivery
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent and corporate service provider, Belize
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Finalize the corporate kit containing the Certificate of Incorporation, Articles of Incorporation, board minutes and resolutions, share certificates, corporate seal, statutory registers, and beneficial ownership register required under the Belize Beneficial Ownership Act. Deliver certified copies to the beneficial owner and file beneficial ownership particulars with the Registry's secure database; no annual return is due until the first anniversary of incorporation.
required_dossiers: Complete corporate kit documents
Beneficial ownership register and filing acknowledgment
Certified copy of Certificate of Incorporation and Articles of Incorporation
First annual government fee schedule and payment record
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry's beneficial ownership portal rejects the submission, resubmit with corrected tax identification and electronic signature enrollment; missing particulars are cured by an amending notice filed within 14 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial licensing board is triggered for this digital software publishing activity; the Belize Trade and Investment Development Service (BELTRAIDE) serves as the general investment facilitation agency, and the Belize Financial Services Commission regulates licensed financial conduct only, neither of which mandates an industrial permit for a non-resident IBC.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None required - simulated social casino publishing under ISIC 5820 is outside the scope of the Lotteries and Gaming Control Act (Cap. 145), which licenses only real-money gaming; the operative distribution licenses are the Apple App Store and Google Play developer agreements, with Apple IAP and Google Play Billing as the authorized payment rails.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of the Environment (DoE), Ministry of Sustainable Development, Climate Change and Disaster Risk Management, Belize
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - software-only venture with no physical plant or manufacturing; no EIA Report or environmental registration is triggered under the Environmental Protection Act (Cap. 328) for ISIC 5820 virtual slots publishing.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero applicable industrial discharge thresholds: no wastewater, VOC, or hazardous waste streams are generated. If a physical office is later opened in Belize, general municipal solid waste handling rules of the Solid Waste Management Authority and standard commercial waste collection would apply at de minimis levels.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not mandated for an offshore IBC with no brick-and-mortar presence. If a leased office or local employees are later contemplated, pre-occupancy clearances would include a fire safety certificate and structural load and occupancy inspection from the Belize National Fire Service, together with Department of Labour workplace registration and occupational safety inspection under the Labour Act (Cap. 297).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Belize Tax Services Department (BTSD), Ministry of Finance and Economic Development, Government of Belize; online portal: https://www.belizetax.gov.bz (e-services available through the Belize Tax Services e-Services system).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Business Company (IBC) is incorporated and maintained by the Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR). No automatic TIN is issued upon incorporation because an IBC is statutorily tax-exempt and prohibited from domestic business activities. If a TIN is required for international banking, FATCA/CRS compliance, or counterparty due diligence, the IBC may apply to BTSD using the prescribed Tax Registration Application form (Form TR-1), accompanied by the Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association, the registered agent certificate, and the annual license fee receipt. BTSD will register the entity as a non-resident or foreign-controlled company for administrative/tax information purposes and assign a Tax Identification Number. An IBC cannot be registered for General Sales Tax (GST) unless it elects to convert to a domestic company or performs taxable domestic supplies, in which case the normal domestic GST registration procedure applies.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Under the International Business Companies Act (Cap. 270), an IBC may apply to the Registrar of Companies to be continued into Belize as an IBC from a foreign jurisdiction or may elect to be converted into a domestic company under the Companies Act (often via special resolution and registered agent application). Conversion to a domestic company results in the loss of IBC tax exemption and submission to Belize income tax, business tax, and GST registration. No US-style check-the-box election or India/EU-style hybrid mismatch election is recognized under Belize tax law; entity tax classification is determined solely by the statute under which the company is registered.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: BZD 75,000 annual taxable turnover (including taxable supplies) is the mandatory GST registration threshold; for an IBC conducting exclusively offshore business with no domestic supplies, no GST registration is required and the threshold is not applicable unless the IBC converts to a domestic taxable business.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Belize does not currently impose a mandatory real-time electronic invoicing or fiscal clearance regime. GST-registered businesses must issue tax invoices containing the prescribed particulars, and export invoices must clearly indicate zero-rating and reference supporting export documentation. There is no statutory API-based e-invoicing clearance, no digital stamping requirement, and no fiscal printer mandate under Belize GST law.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available to a GST-registered supplier on: (a) the export of goods physically removed from Belize by the supplier or at the supplier's direction; and (b) the supply of services provided to a recipient who is outside Belize, where the services are used or enjoyed wholly outside Belize and the supplier retains documentary proof of the foreign destination and foreign recipient. For an IBC operating as a social casino/free-to-play games publisher, offshore revenues derived from non-resident users are not domestic supplies; accordingly they are outside the Belize GST charge and, if the IBC remains tax-exempt, no zero-rating refund mechanism is required. If the IBC elects domestic company status, it may claim zero-rating on its export of software license rights and related offshore services by maintaining a full audit trail of export evidence.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Belize Customs Department Single Administrative Document or equivalent electronic export entry)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical movement of goods out of Belize (where applicable)
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank/FX receipt evidencing foreign currency receipt from the offshore purchaser
Commercial invoice and executed sales/license contract
Packing list and certificate of origin (if required)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The BTSD and Belize Customs Department may audit export zero-rating claims for up to six years after the filing date. Intentional or fraudulent overclaiming of zero-rating or the submission of forged export documentation attracts civil penalties of up to 200% of the tax under-charged, statutory interest, and criminal fines with imprisonment up to five years under the General Sales Tax Act and the Customs and Excise Duty Act. Retrospective clawbacks of zero-rated refunds, denial of future refund claims, deregistration with immediate effect, and loss of IBC tax-exempt status are also possible if the entity is found to have engaged in domestic economic activity or to have misrepresented the offshore nature of its supplies.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Central Bank of Belize (established under the Central Bank of Belize Act, Chapter 262, Laws of Belize, Revised Edition 2020) is the monetary authority and exchange control administrator, acting through its Exchange Control Department and in coordination with the International Financial Services Commission (IFSC) for offshore/international banking and fiduciary licensing. Governing instruments include the Exchange Control Act (Chapter 263), the Exchange Control Regulations (Revised Edition 2020, as amended by Central Bank Notices), the International Business Companies Act (Chapter 270, as amended), and the AML/CFT Act 2013 with oversight by the Financial Intelligence Unit of Belize. The Belize IBC is structurally exempt from exchange control pursuant to Section 46 of the IBC Act, which disapplies the Exchange Control Act with respect to an IBC's foreign currency, gold, securities, and payments to or by the company.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Belizean Dollar (BZD) operates under a hard peg of BZD 2.00 = USD 1.00 maintained since 1976, providing full USD convertibility at the official rate for current account transactions through authorized dealers. Capital account transactions by residents, including outward investment, offshore deposits, and foreign securities purchases, require prior Central Bank approval and evidentiary documentation. Profit and dividend remittance by a Belize IBC is entirely unrestricted: Section 6 of the IBC Act exempts the IBC from all Belize taxes, including income, capital gains, withholding, and stamp duties, and the exchange control exemption permits immediate repatriation of USD/EUR balances without any Central Bank certificate, surrender obligation, or remittance tax. Non-resident shareholders face no convertibility limitation on legitimate corporate payments such as licensing fees, cloud infrastructure costs, logistics, and professional fees. Practical restriction: an exempt IBC is generally not permitted to conduct BZD deposit-taking or local domestic trading; all treasury operations must be denominated in freely convertible foreign currency.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Resident exporters in Belize are subject to the general exchange control surrender regime: foreign currency proceeds from goods exports and non-exempt 'invisible' services must be repatriated through an authorized dealer and, in the absence of a retention license, surrendered or made available for conversion into BZD within the prescribed period fixed by Central Bank Notices (enforcement is invoice/settlement-statement based, with a 90-180 day compliance expectation). The mandatory conversion ratio is effectively 100% of repatriated proceeds for non-exempt persons. The Belize IBC is entirely outside this regime: Section 46 of the IBC Act removes the surrender and conversion obligations. Accordingly, Apple IAP and Google Play Billing USD settlements may be retained offshore in full, converted only at the company's commercial choice, and settled into the IBC's foreign currency account at an authorized dealer or an international bank with zero Central Bank surrender documentation.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD/EUR settlement account; escrow-capable holding account
Operational USD account; reserve treasury ledger
Operational USD/EUR account with domestic correspondent access
Operational USD account with multi-currency card clearing and SWIFT access

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW-MEDIUM. Belize law has no e-money institution (EMI) charter; the IFSC licenses only international banks and money remitters. Foreign digital EMIs (UK FCA-authorised, EU e-money licensed, or Hong Kong/Singapore payment institutions) generally accept Belize IBCs as jurisdiction, but proprietary underwriting engines frequently auto-decline casino-adjacent scopes. Legal constraint: an EMI must not be used as the primary cash repository for the social casino treasury; it may serve only as a pass-through payout rail for employee disbursements or as a secondary USD account. Recommended compliant alternative: open the primary USD settlement account at Caye International Bank or Heritage International Bank (both digitally oriented, IBC-fluent, with US correspondent clearing), and use a regulated EU EMI solely for high-speed contractor payout cards, presenting the EMI with the complete Belize corporate pack, UBO attestation, legal opinion, and live Apple/Google payout statements to survive enhanced due diligence.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: There is no statutory requirement for directors to appear physically in Belize. The AML/CFT (Amendment) Regulations and Central Bank licensing standards oblige banks to complete customer identification procedures prior to account activation; in practice, Belize tier-1 banks accept (a) IFSC-registered agent attestation of corporate record correctness, (b) notarised or apostilled certified passport copies and proof of residential address, (c) a live recorded video interview with at least one director and each material UBO conducted via bank-compliant secure video, and (d) a bankers' reference from the shareholder's existing financial institution. Fully remote onboarding without a physical visit is achievable at Caye International Bank and Heritage International Bank; however, the 'virtual slots/social casino' business scope requires a mandatory recorded compliance interview and submission of the full de-risking defence file, not merely standard email KYC. A physical appearance in Belize is not legally mandated and is not recommended as a de-risking measure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: 'virtual slots', 'social casino' and gambling-adjacent scope keywords trigger automatic decline by retail and offshore bank compliance engines
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (a) executed Apple Developer Program License Agreement and Google Play Developer Distribution Agreement evidencing approval as a simulated social casino; (b) certified App Store/Play Store category 'Casino - Simulation' listing screenshots; (c) current EULA and Terms of Service demonstrating zero real-money wagering, withdrawal, or prize redemption; (d) independent legal opinion from Belize counsel confirming the product falls outside 'betting or gaming' under the Gaming Control Act (Cap. 151) and the International Gaming Act 2018, plus opinion from US/EU counsel distinguishing social casino from regulated online gambling in target markets; (e) gameplay session flow documentation proving in-app purchases acquire only non-withdrawable virtual credits.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity: Belize IBC with nominee shareholders, legacy bearer share issuance, or unregistered UBO chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (a) current Beneficial Ownership Register extract filed with the Belize Registry under Sections 16A-16C of the IBC Act; (b) registered agent compliance certificate issued under the AML/CFT Act; (c) complete corporate chain chart to natural persons with passports, residential proof, and source-of-wealth statements for each UBO holding above 10%; (d) signed declaration confirming no bearer shares and an undertaking to notify the bank of any share transfer within 14 days; (e) professional letter from the incorporating law firm attesting to the corporate record.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds shortfall: newly incorporated IBC with no operating history, no prior receivables, and limited time since formation, receiving recurring consumer settlement from Apple/Google
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: (a) registered Apple App Store Connect and Google Play Console payout banking details showing the IBC as named beneficiary; (b) 12-month revenue forecast with platform commission structure and net settlement projections; (c) executed development, marketing, cloud hosting, and support vendor contracts evidencing forecast operating costs; (d) three months of founder bank/card statements supporting legitimate accumulation of incorporation capital and app-development expenditure; (e) certificate of good standing from the Belize Registrar, confirming capital subscriptions are fully recorded.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (Office of the Registrar of Companies) under the Companies Act / International Business Companies regime
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 20 days after the company's incorporation anniversary date; where the anniversary falls on a non-business day, the filing is due on the next business day.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharge of 10% of the applicable annual fee is imposed for each month or part of a month after the statutory deadline. Continued default beyond 90 days triggers administrative strike-off proceedings, followed by dissolution after notice in the Belize Gazette.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Belize Financial Services Commission / International Business Companies Registry, paid through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on or before the annual renewal date designated by the Registrar, which is generally the incorporation anniversary month; the payment window closes on the last calendar day of the anniversary month.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-payment by the cut-off date subjects the company to late-payment penalties and a reactivation fee. Failure to pay for two consecutive years permits the Registrar to strike off the IBC and place its assets in the custody of the Financial Services Commission until restoration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A compulsory independent audit is not mandatory for a private International Business Company unless: (i) the company is publicly accountable; (ii) it prepares consolidated financial statements; (iii) it is directed by the Belize Financial Services Commission or the Registrar of Companies; or (iv) it is part of a regulated financial or money-service business subject to Central Bank of Belize AML/CFT audit requirements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the International Accounting Standards Board, with the Belize-adapted IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities available to IBCs that are not publicly accountable. Accounting records must reflect a true and fair view if an audit or review is prepared.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every IBC must maintain a register of ultimate beneficial owners at its registered office. An annual confirmation must be delivered to the registered agent and the Registrar of Companies no later than the annual return deadline. The confirmation must identify every individual holding 10% or more of the issued shares or exercising ultimate control through any voting, employment, or contractual arrangement. Any shareholding transfer that changes beneficial ownership must be endorsed in the register and communicated to the registered agent within 15 days of the transfer.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$2,500–US$7,500 for a full statutory audit; US$800–US$2,000 for a review engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for a Belize International Business Company (IBC) under section 6 of the IBC Act; ordinary Belize-resident companies are otherwise subject to a 25% corporate income tax rate if the IBC exemption is lost.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption from Belize income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, stamp duty, and exchange-control restrictions for qualifying offshore activities; no payroll or business tax is imposed on IBC income. The only recurring state charge is the annual license and registration fee. No preferential deduction or time-limited tax holiday is necessary, as the exemption is absolute while IBC status is maintained.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IBC Annual Regulatory Return (Form 1 to the Registrar of International Business Companies); no corporate income tax return is required for a fully exempt IBC. E-filed via the Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry online portal operated by the Belize Financial Services Commission (IFSC) or through the licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 28 calendar days after each anniversary of incorporation, unless the Registrar grants an extension. The annual license fee is payable at the same anniversary date, with the fee becoming delinquent after the statutory grace period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique registration number issued on the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter exactly as shown on the certificate; do not add foreign prefixes or tax identifiers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full registered corporate name of the IBC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List both legal names if a dual-name IBC is registered; state the name appearing on commercial invoices.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the registered office maintained in Belize.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A street address in Belize is mandatory; a post office box is insufficient. The address must be in the charge of the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and address of the licensed registered agent in Belize.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent must be a licensed Belize IBC manager, lawyer, or qualified corporate service provider. Foreign counsel may appear only as an additional contact.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, residential addresses, and nationalities of all directors.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors may provide overseas residential addresses; no Belize work permit or residency is required for directorship.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and addresses of shareholders and the class and percentage of shares held.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Bearer shares are prohibited. Beneficial ownership information is collected separately under the AML/CFT and beneficial ownership transparency rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 - Authorized and Issued Share Capital
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Amount of authorized capital, classes of shares, and paid-up issued capital.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Belize IBCs have no minimum capital requirement; the capital can be expressed in USD or Belize dollars.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing is penalized at BZD 250 per month or part thereof. Non-payment of the annual license fee attracts a 10% late charge plus daily surcharges after the grace period; persistent default for three months empowers the Registrar to strike the IBC off the register without a court order. Restoration is discretionary and requires settlement of arrears, penalties, and reinstatement costs up to BZD 1,000.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Return (ESR Annual Return) filed electronically through the IFSC ESR portal via the licensed registered agent; no widely published form number is assigned.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 6 months after the end of the IBC's financial year. A reduced substance reporting regime applies to passive holding companies, but it still requires an annual filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Select the relevant activity from the statutory list, including Intellectual Property Business, Distribution and Service Centre, and Provision of Services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A social casino and virtual slots publisher holding or exploiting game software IP should normally select Intellectual Property Business. If income is primarily operational advertising or development services, the filer must assess whether Distribution and Service Centre or another category more accurately applies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disclose place of management and control, address and type of premises in Belize, number of full-time employees, and total operating expenditure in Belize.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Booking revenue through a mailbox office is insufficient. Non-resident directors must show actual board meetings, decision-making, and service contracts managed from Belize.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identify the core activities that generate revenue, such as IP development, maintenance, protection, and exploitation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For IP business, the core income-generating activities must be carried on in Belize to the extent required for economic substance. The filer must provide a factual narrative, not a boilerplate declaration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part D - Declaration and Authorized Signature
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certified declaration signed by a director or officer and countersigned by the registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may sign remotely, but the statement must be certified by the Belize registered agent. False declarations expose signatories to criminal and civil penalties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to satisfy the economic substance test attracts a strict liability penalty of BZD 50,000, plus BZD 5,000 per month of continuing default. Late filing penalties may reach BZD 10,000. The competent authority may also apply for strike-off, director disqualification, and automatic exchange of information with the parent and ultimate beneficial owner jurisdictions.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% on dividends paid by a Belize IBC to its shareholders, whether residents or non-residents. The IBC Act expressly exempts IBC distributions from Belize withholding tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: A Belize IBC is not subject to Belize income tax and therefore cannot ordinarily satisfy the 'resident' test for comprehensive double taxation agreement relief. Belize has no meaningful OECD-style DTA network, although the CARICOM Double Taxation Agreement may apply among CARICOM member states. In practice, DTA relief is unnecessary for outbound IBC distributions because the Belize withholding rate is already zero. If a foreign payer nevertheless demands treaty documentation, the IBC must apply to the Belize Income Tax Department for a tax residency certificate; such a certificate will normally be refused because the IBC is exempt. The proper substitute package is the certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, incumbency certificate, and a notarized representation of non-residence for Belize tax purposes.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% on royalties and interest paid by an exempt IBC to non-residents. If the entity were taxable as an ordinary Belize company, the domestic non-resident withholding rate is 15% on interest and royalties; a limited treaty rate may apply only where an applicable CARICOM or bilateral agreement is in force and the claimant proves residence.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer pricing documentation threshold applies to an exempt IBC because it is outside the Belize income tax net. As an administrative reference, the Belize tax/IFSC authorities expect contemporaneous Local File and Master File documentation for cross-border related-party transactions exceeding BZD 5,000,000 in an annual accounting period, and full economic substance records regardless of transaction value.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Business Companies (Economic Substance) Act, as amended, requires a Belize IBC carrying on a relevant activity to maintain substantial economic presence in Belize. For a simulated social-casino and virtual-slots publisher with proprietary game IP, the relevant activity is likely Intellectual Property Business. The IBC must demonstrate management and control in Belize, maintain a local registered office and, where appropriate, a physical presence, employ adequate local or offshore personnel directed from Belize, and incur sufficient operating expenditure in Belize. A pure holding company has reduced substance but cannot be a nominee-only shell. Failure to file the ESR return or to satisfy the substance test triggers automatic penalties and possible strike-off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Abusive Use of IBC Exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Conducting Belize-source business with local consumers, hiring Belize employees, maintaining local management control in Belize, or deriving revenue from Belize real property while claiming full IBC tax exemption; alternatively, diverting taxable revenue from a foreign residence jurisdiction into the IBC with no commercial substance, with the intent to evade foreign tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Loss of the IBC exemption and reassessment to 25% corporate income tax on Belize-source profits, plus interest, and a statutory penalty of up to 100% of the understated tax. Criminal prosecution under the Belize Income Tax Act may result in fines up to BZD 50,000 and imprisonment up to 3 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who knowingly authorized the evasion are jointly and severally liable for the corporate tax, penalties, and civil restitution. The court may impose travel bans, restraint orders, asset confiscation, and disqualification orders under the Companies Act.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False Economic Substance Certification / Shell Company
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Certifying in the ESR return that employees, premises, and expenditure exist when they do not; operating the IBC as a pure shell with no management and control in Belize; failing to file the ESR return within six months of the financial year-end; or knowingly providing false information to the Registrar or IFSC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strict liability penalty of BZD 50,000 plus BZD 5,000 per month of continuing default under the Economic Substance legislation. The regulator may also impose additional fines for late or materially inaccurate filings, initiate strike-off proceedings, and exchange information with foreign tax authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed false substance declarations may be personally fined up to BZD 25,000 and imprisoned for up to 2 years. Additional consequences include disqualification from managing a company for up to 5 years, travel bans in fraud cases, and an order to disgorge benefits obtained through the false declaration.
